credit: Source: GeoNames, Ukrainian postal code dump, 13 October 2026.
identity: one row per postcode and locality; a row is kept when the dump lists its locality under the same code, exactly or after an accent, case and punctuation fold
changes_by_csc: Existing rows the dump lists were kept and took its locality name, point and state; a field the dump's rows disagree on is left empty; points formatted to eight decimals; no new codes added.
state_mapping: GeoNames admin1 to the CSC state iso2 by the provider table https://www.geonames.org/UA/administrative-division-ukraine.html; postal 12 and 13 follow the published Order 121 allocation (12 -> 32, 13 -> 30)
